Read WUENIC coverage inputs for country prioritization

read_GSAP_immunity_data.Rd

Reads the long-format country sheet from a WUENIC workbook and returns one country-level table. The default follows the population-immunity analysis: filter by year and vaccine, reshape coverage to one row per country, and calculate the DTP1, DTP3, and IPV1 complements. Country labels are standardized here because the workbook is an external input; other prioritization inputs are expected to already use the package country key.

Usage

read_GSAP_immunity_data(
  path,
  sheet = "country",
  year = NULL,
  target_grp = NULL,
  include_coverage = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

str Path to the WUENIC Excel workbook.

sheet

str Workbook sheet containing the long-format country data.

year

integer Optional WUENIC year. If omitted, the maximum year available after filtering to the requested vaccines is used. The year is selected before any target_grp filter is applied. All three requested vaccines must have data for that year and target group.

target_grp

str Optional WUENIC target group. NULL (the default) ignores this field; provide a value only when an explicit target-group filter is needed.

include_coverage

logical Include the source coverage columns in addition to the complement columns. Defaults to FALSE, matching the reference analysis.

Value

A tibble with Country, zero.dose.pct, under.immun.pct, and no.ipv1.pct; coverage columns are included when requested.
